          return render json: { error: "Invalid request payload" }, status: :bad_request
        end

        permitted = request_attrs.permit(:status, comment: [ :body ])

        has_comment = request_attrs.key?(:comment)
        has_status = permitted.key?(:status) && !permitted[:status].nil?

        unless has_comment || has_status
          return render json: { error: "Comment or status is required" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        if has_status && permitted[:status].to_s != "solved"
          if Ticket::STATUSES.include?(permitted[:status].to_s)
            return render json: { error: "Customers can only mark requests as solved" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
          else
            return render json: { error: "Status is not included in the list" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
          end
        end

        if has_comment && !request_attrs[:comment].is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)
          return render json: { error: "Comment must be an object" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
          if has_comment
            comment_body = permitted.dig(:comment, :body)
            ticket.comments.create!(
              author: current_user,
              body: comment_body,
              public: true
            )

            if has_status
              ticket.update!(status: "solved")
            elsif ticket.status.in?(%w[pending solved])
              ticket.update!(status: "open")
            end
          elsif has_status
            ticket.update!(status: "solved")
          end
        end

        render json: { request: ticket.reload.as_request_json }, status: :ok
      end

      def comments
        ticket = customer_requests.find(params[:id])
        scope = ticket.comments.public_only.includes(:author).oldest_first
        result = paginate(scope)

        render json: result[:meta].merge(
          comments: result[:records].map(&:as_api_json)
        ), status: :ok
      end

      private

      def customer_requests
        current_account.tickets.where(requester_id: current_user.id)
      end
    end
  end
end
